queer_characters.name: Sergey
queer_characters.notes: Described as a gay Soviet airman based on a real person; his romance with Roman is central and framed against Soviet-era persecution.

queer_characters.name: Roman
queer_characters.notes: A gay fighter pilot and Sergey's lover; his death in the Soviet-Afghan War concludes the film, reflecting a tragic queer arc set in a repressive historical period.

contributor_notes: Based on a true story of two Soviet Air Force servicemen during the Cold War. Both leads are explicitly gay per the source. Rep flagged as historical-context given the Soviet-era setting and persecution; bury-your-gays/tragic-queer noted because Roman dies and the couple is forcibly separated, leaving Sergey alone. No creator identity info provided in source. Subtitle/audio languages not stated despite Estonian/British co-production—please verify.
